about: One real cell for each of the 26 distinct morphological types of Markram et al. (2015), Cell 163:456, rat somatosensory cortex, from the Open Brain Institute's EntityCore - each type once, not once per layer: the interneurons of layers 2 to 6 from layer 2/3, but for the Martinotti cell (layer 5) and the nest basket cell (layer 4); the layer 2/3 pyramidal cell standing for the pyramidal cells, and the layer 5 untufted cell for the untufted. Each the least-scaled, non-cloned repaired reconstruction, the most complete of the first three (by axon for interneurons, dendrites for pyramidal cells). um, soma at 0, y towards the pia; terminal twigs pruned and points simplified to at most 450, as drawn small. The pyramidal types' newer OBI labels stand for the 2015 ones (e.g. L5_TPC:A for TTPC1).
